sources.title: RFC 8555: Automatic Certificate Management Environment
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: OpenSSH 憑證：短效存取與主體範圍
related.titleEn: OpenSSH certificates: short-lived access and principal scope
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：10與5日餘裕可重算，所有端點與服務實際載入的證據分開；私鑰與DNS驗證權杖不進課程報告。 交付訂單狀態機、端點序號清單與續期故障時間預算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 10 and 5 days and separate issuance from endpoint loading evidence; keep private keys and DNS validation tokens out of reports. Deliver an order state machine, endpoint serial inventory and renewal failure budget.
related.difference: 畫出管理者、簽發端、跳板與目標測試主機；區分主機身分驗證和使用者授權，為每張合成憑證列principal、有效期與序號。
related.differenceEn: Map administrator, signer, bastion and test host; distinguish host authentication from user authorization and list principal, validity and serial per synthetic certificate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 續期餘裕=到期日−開始續期日；可重試預算需另扣維護或故障時間，成功下載憑證不表示所有服務都已更新。 教學憑證在第30日到期，原定第20日開始續期；這些日期是示例而非公開CA有效期規則。 30−20=10日餘裕；若延至第25日開始則只剩5日。
登入時剩餘生命=TTL−簽發到使用的延遲；仍需符合principal與主機信任，剩餘時間大於零不是唯一准入條件。 教學憑證TTL60分鐘，簽發至登入延遲10分鐘；時鐘同步且無額外寬限。 60−10=50分鐘可用；TTL縮為30分鐘後剩20分鐘。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Renewal margin is expiry day minus renewal-start day; maintenance and outages consume it, and a downloaded certificate does not prove every service updated. A teaching certificate expires on day 30 and renewal starts on day 20; these are invented dates, not public-CA validity rules. 30−20=10 days of margin; delaying start to day 25 leaves 5 days.

Remaining lifetime at login equals TTL minus issuance-to-use delay; principal and host trust must also match, so positive lifetime alone does not authorize access. Teaching TTL is 60 minutes and issuance-to-login delay 10 minutes, with synchronized clocks and no grace interval. 60−10=50 usable minutes; TTL 30 leaves 20 minutes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DMARC：SPF、DKIM 與網域對齊證據
related.titleEn: DMARC: SPF, DKIM and domain-alignment evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：10與5日餘裕可重算，所有端點與服務實際載入的證據分開；私鑰與DNS驗證權杖不進課程報告。 交付訂單狀態機、端點序號清單與續期故障時間預算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 10 and 5 days and separate issuance from endpoint loading evidence; keep private keys and DNS validation tokens out of reports. Deliver an order state machine, endpoint serial inventory and renewal failure budget.
related.difference: 以合成郵件列From、Return-Path、DKIM d=與各驗證結果；分開標示SPF通過、DKIM通過及對齊，不把單項pass直接當DMARC通過。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate From, Return-Path, DKIM d= and results for synthetic mail; distinguish raw SPF/DKIM pass from alignment.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 續期餘裕=到期日−開始續期日；可重試預算需另扣維護或故障時間，成功下載憑證不表示所有服務都已更新。 教學憑證在第30日到期，原定第20日開始續期；這些日期是示例而非公開CA有效期規則。 30−20=10日餘裕；若延至第25日開始則只剩5日。
DMARC通過集合=已對齊SPF通過 OR 已對齊DKIM通過；聯集需扣重疊，並另處理轉寄與郵件清單的合法變形。 400封合成郵件中，300封SPF已對齊通過、280封DKIM已對齊通過，250封同時符合。 聯集300+280−250=330封，通過率82.5%；DKIM改320且重疊270時聯集350封、87.5%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Renewal margin is expiry day minus renewal-start day; maintenance and outages consume it, and a downloaded certificate does not prove every service updated. A teaching certificate expires on day 30 and renewal starts on day 20; these are invented dates, not public-CA validity rules. 30−20=10 days of margin; delaying start to day 25 leaves 5 days.

DMARC passing set is aligned SPF pass OR aligned DKIM pass; subtract overlap and separately examine legitimate forwarding/list transformations. Among 400 synthetic messages, 300 pass aligned SPF, 280 pass aligned DKIM and 250 pass both. Union is 300+280−250=330 messages or 82.5%; DKIM 320 and overlap 270 yield 350 or 87.5%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
